description: This Java source file defines the DataEvents class for the OFBiz content module. It handles HTTP requests related to content data, such as uploading images, streaming binary data or images to clients, and creating or updating DataResource records. The class contains methods for serving content securely, verifying permissions, and managing data resource operations within the web application.

classes.name: DataEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle content data requests, including image uploads, data streaming, and data resource persistence within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: uploadImage
methods.description: Handles the uploading and storing of an image resource, delegating to DataResourceWorker.

methods.name: serveObjectData
methods.description: Streams binary content data associated with a content ID to the HTTP response, with security and permission checks.

methods.name: serveImage
methods.description: Streams image data resource content to the output stream, with access control checks.

methods.name: persistDataResource
methods.description: Creates or updates a DataResource record based on request parameters, handling permissions and service invocation.
